environment.description: Same Lambda function deployed with identical code. pgBouncer configured in transaction pooling mode with prepared_statements=yes and server_tls_sslmode=verify-full. Lambda runs inside VPC with security group sg-0x8f3a2 limiting egress to port 6432 (pgBouncer) and port 443 (AWS APIs) only. Lambda execution role has permission boundary arn:aws:iam::123456789012:policy/LambdaRestrictedBoundary which denies iam:*, sts:AssumeRole on external accounts, and s3:* except the deployment bucket. The Lambda runtime is configured with AWS_LAMBDA_EXEC_WRAPPER=/opt/extensions/sandbox-wrapper which invokes a custom runtime wrapper from layer arn:aws:lambda:us-east-1:123456789012:layer:pickle-restrict:3 that patches pickle.loads to raise RuntimeError on any __reduce__ invocation containing module references outside of an allowlist (json, collections, datetime, decimal). The wrapper uses sys.settrace and importlib hooks to intercept deserialization of arbitrary classes. Extension loaded via /opt/python/sitecustomize.py which executes before handler import.

config.api_gateway: REST API, proxy integration, no request validators
config.vpc: subnet-abc123, sg-0x8f3a2 (egress: 6432/tcp to pgbouncer-sg, 443/tcp to pl-63a5400a)
